title: Section 230.33 – Revise Section 230.33 to read as follows:
officialText:
230.33 Spliced Conductors. Service conductors shall be permitted to be spliced or tapped in accordance with
300.5(E), 300.13, and 300.15. For underground service conductors, the requirements of 230.46(C) shall apply.
